project.description: HuntAI QA · real Jenkins failure job. The archived JUnit report contains one failure, so Jenkins marks the build UNSTABLE; the platform must normalize it to FAILED.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: branch
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Branch under test (passed by the platform through params_schema).

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -eu set +x
BRANCH_SAFE="$(printf '%s' "${branch:-main}" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_')"
send_started() { local body sig body="$(printf '{"job":{"name":"%s"},"build":{"number":%s,"phase":"STARTED","status":""}}' "$JOB_NAME" "$BUILD_NUMBER")" sig="$(printf '%s' "$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$JENKINS_WEBHOOK_SECRET" -r | cut -d' ' -f1)" curl -fsS -X POST "$HUNTAI_BASE_URL/api/v1/inbound-webhooks/$HUNTAI_CI_CONNECTOR_ID" \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H "x-hub-signature-256: sha256=$sig" \ -H "x-github-delivery: jenkins-$JOB_NAME-$BUILD_NUMBER-started-$(date +%s)-$$" \ -H 'x-github-event: ci_build' \ --data-binary "$body" >/dev/null \ || echo "WARN: STARTED webhook failed (the completed webhook can still resume the run)" >&2 }
send_started
cat > junit.xml <<'XML' <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <testsuite name="full-flow-fail" tests="1" failures="1" errors="0" skipped="0" time="0.1"> <testcase classname="huntai.qa.jenkins" name="jenkins_failure_is_visible" time="0.1"> <failure message="intentional failure for failure-triage demo">Expected 200, got 500 (synthetic Jenkins report)</failure> </testcase> </testsuite> XML
printf '{"job":"%s","build":%s,"branch":"%s","result":"failed"}\n' \ "$JOB_NAME" "$BUILD_NUMBER" "$BRANCH_SAFE" > report.json
echo "full-flow-fail: branch=$BRANCH_SAFE build=$BUILD_NUMBER" echo "junit.xml contains one intentional failure"
